headers.seed_subset:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V)) (tape : Tape V J)
    (h : ℕ) (l : List (Sym2 V)) : Q⊆edges Q w t eligible host tape h l
headers.subset_input:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V)) (tape : Tape V J)
    (h : ℕ) (l : List (Sym2 V)) : edges Q w t eligible host tape h l⊆Q∪l.toFinset
headers.one_vote_iff:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V)) (tape : Tape V J)
    (E : Finset (Sym2 V)) (e : Sym2 V) :
    1≤(votes Q w t eligible host tape E e).card ↔
      ∃ j∈eligible e,3/8≤estimate Q E (host j) w t e (tape E e j)
headers.voter_true_probability:
(Q E T : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (f : ℕ) (e : Sym2 V) (draws : List (Finset (Sym2 V)))
    (hvote : 3/8≤estimate Q E T w t e draws)
    (hacc : |estimate Q E T w t e draws-testProbability Q E T w t f e|≤1/8) :
    1/4≤testProbability Q E T w t f e
